**Schiffer · 2009 · 临床**

Psychological benefits 2 and 4 weeks after a single treatment with near infrared light to the forehead

*Behavioral and Brain Functions* · [DOI: 10.1186/1744-9081-5-46](https://doi.org/10.1186/1744-9081-5-46) · [阅读全文](https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content)

## 怎么做

```{=html}
<dl class="tp-study-fields">
<div><dt>研究对象</dt><dd>10 名抑郁患者<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>研究设计</dt><dd>同次主动/关灯生理对照，症状为单组随访<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 5–6 页｜设计与图 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>波长</dt><dd>810 nm 峰值，半高宽 40 nm<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>连续光 / 脉冲</dt><dd>LED；照射时序见方法<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 5–6 页｜设计与图 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射位置</dt><dd>前额 F3、F4<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>辐照度 / 功率</dt><dd>距皮肤 4 mm 时 250 mW/cm²<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>光斑</dt><dd>方法说明距皮肤 4 mm；本表不换算光斑<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射时间与疗程</dt><dd>每点 4 分钟<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>剂量</dt><dd>每点入射 60 J/cm²<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜照射参数与表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>对照怎么做</dt><dd>急性光谱同部位关灯；随访无独立假刺激组<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 5–6 页｜设计与图 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>观察指标</dt><dd>前额总血红蛋白；HAM-D 与 HAM-A<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 5–6 页｜设计与图 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>测量时间</dt><dd>光谱于刺激中；症状基线、2、4 周<br><a href="https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 5–6 页｜设计与图 1</a></dd></div>
</dl>
```

## 结果怎么看

- HAM-D 平均较基线下降 13.2 和 6.5 分。（[PDF 第 9 页｜图 3、表 4](https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=9)）
- 双侧平均总血红蛋白开灯相对关灯差 0.032 相对单位，p = 0.16。（[PDF 第 8 页｜图 2](https://dash.harvard.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/7312037c-71e1-6bd4-e053-0100007fdf3b/content#page=8)）

## 对实验设计有什么用

把即刻生理对照与独立、等时程的症状对照分别设计，预先规定随访时点。
